title: Equality detected on the open of a finite depth-two source
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme and $U\subset L$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $r:F\to L$ be finite and $p:E\to L$ affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-affine-morphism]. Assume $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{F,z}\geq2$ for every $z$ with $r(z)\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $f,g:F\to E$ satisfy $pf=r=pg$. If $\iota_F f=\iota_F g$ on $F\times_L U$, then $f=g$.

source.place: Tag 0EY6, converse in the proof of (2); Tags 0AUK, 0E9I and 01SA

proof.text: Since r is finite, F is locally Noetherian. Identify the stalk of its structure module with its local ring by the filtered-colimit comparison for forgetting rings to abelian groups; compatibility of scalar multiplication follows on germs. Transport finiteness and depth along this linear equivalence (regular sequences and ideal times module are invariant). Apply positive-depth restriction injectivity to the structure module on F and W = r inverse U. The structure module is quasi-coherent and finite on every affine open. Depth at least two implies depth at least one. Thus W.ι.app V is injective for every open V of F.

For every open V of L, form the appLE ring maps induced by f and g from sections on p inverse V to sections on r inverse V. The equality on W, followed by appLE_comp_appLE, identifies their composites with W.ι.app (r inverse V). Cancel this injective ring map pointwise. In the anti-equivalence for affine morphisms over L these are exactly the section components of the two algebra maps, by its hmap formula. Extensionality and the faithful functor give equality of the two Over L morphisms, hence f = g.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0B3M and 05AR (positive-depth restriction injectivity) and 01SA (faithfulness for affine morphisms), applied directly to the source structure module; this avoids the finite-local-algebra depth formula and the surjectivity part of Hartogs.

    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {F E : Scheme.{u}} (r : F ⟶ L) (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite r] [IsAffineHom p]

    (f g : F ⟶ E) (hf : f ≫ p = r) (hg : g ≫ p = r)
    (hfg : (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f = (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ g) : f = g
